t: A page of AI ethics readings, guides, and a microlearning course for students and educators.
steps: Find the resource page from the NMSU Youth Workforce Innovation Center.
Skim the three student resources and the three educator resources.
Pick one reading or lesson for a first class.
Check each outside site against school filtering rules.
Download the PDF on bias in AI systems from the NMSU site.
Plan a discussion using the Adapt Centre guide.
